title: Known-object test, TOI-2666.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-2666.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 10, 3.5, 5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 0.5%, 0.5%, 0.5% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 20%, 30%, 30%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 59 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 32 distinct event(s), 3 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2461049.1644 (ΔT 1790.01 d); 52 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
